entries.title: Psalms 137:1
segments: When God punishes a nation for its sins, good men share in its calamities.

entries.title: Psalms 137:6
segments: The true children of God prefer the welfare of his people above their chief; and are more grieved for the calamities that come upon his church, than for any private losses and sufferings of their own.

entries.title: Psalms 137:7
segments: In the day of Jerusalem; in the day of her overthrow.  The sin here laid to the charge of the Edomites is that of rejoicing in and helping forward the destruction of Jerusalem.

entries.title: Psalms 137:8
segments:
Daughter of Babylon; the people of Babylon represented under the figure of a woman. 
 
  Happy shall he be; because he has executed God's purpose.
That rewardeth thee as thou hast served us; a prophetic announcement from God of the coming doom of Edom.  See

entries.title: Psalms 137:9
segments: God is displeased with all who rejoice in the affliction of his servants, and will recompense their iniquity into their own bosom.
